card.name: Deep-time ages in millions of years
card.fires_on: Numbers (and the decimal point or space before them) giving geological or fossil ages, such as 3.5 billion or 55 million years ago. Also fires on 'Geological' in a passage about the fossil record.

modes.label: Age figures
modes.description: The digits, decimal point or space inside a prehistoric age figure just before 'million' or 'billion years'.
modes.example: Scientists estimate that this common ancestor lived some 3<<.>>5 to 3.8 billion years

modes.label: Geology wording
modes.description: The word 'Geological' in a title about the fossil record.
modes.example: On the<< Geological>> Succession of Organic Beings On

card.writes: It suppresses prehistoric-era words like Neolithic, Stone, Cave and Pale, so it seems to steer away from those after an age figure.
card.plain: It lights up on numbers giving the age of fossils, rocks or the Earth, in millions or billions of years.
